notes.title: Major Update Ver1.1.0
notes.content:
Dear Smith & Dungeon players,

Thank you for playing Smith & Dungeon!
The Ver.1.1.0 major update has been released.

This major update introduces the "Demonic Battleground", a new ultra high-difficulty dungeon.

We've also added new weapon-exclusive enchantments to enhance the battle experience, implemented a feature that allows guild adventurers to change their weapons, and introduced the ability to skip previously cleared stages.

Additionally, we've removed the penalty for withdrawing from explorations and made it easier to obtain material items and gold.

Enjoy the updated Smith & Dungeon!

[h3][b]Release notes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed the penalties for dungeon withdrawal and game over.
All collected materials and gold can now be retained upon exiting a dungeon.
[*]You can now start explorations from previously cleared stages.
[*]Weapons can now be changed based on your friendship level with adventurers.
[*]Added new content: Demonic Battleground.
[*]By learning a specific ability, you can now swap enchantments on equipment.
[*]Adjusted certain item drop contents.
[*]Fixed various bugs.[/list]
[h3][b]Ultra High-Difficulty Dungeon: Demonic Battleground[/b][/h3]
Created by the Demon Lord, the Demonic Battleground is an ultra high-difficulty dungeon with a multi-layered structure.
Players must battle through countless monsters lying in wait, aiming to conquer as many layers as possible.
As you progress, the dungeon's difficulty increases. Powerful bosses appear on certain floors, and defeating them rewards you with rare crafting materials called Mystic Refining Crystals.
Challenge yourself to see how far you can go - and enjoy a brand-new battle experience like never before!
※The Demonic Battleground unlocks after you clear the Demon King's Castle area.

[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354456/ba296014cef46eb86b6bed70c254b73b743ec9db.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354456/5966b20f58d210a4b950c0b1bb38148f3d6300ad.png"][/img][/carousel]
[h3][b]Bless Your Weapons with Divine Power![/b][/h3]
By obtaining Mystic Refining Crystals, you can enhance your weapons with exclusive enchantments that grant powerful additional effects.
These mystical powers transform your weapons into even more formidable tools of battle.
Equip your enhanced gear and take on the ultimate challenge - the ultra high-difficulty Demonic Battleground!

[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354456/cbc2256a1499aa8278a71ef8dc487e7217024694.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354456/27746b52c18bc8550eb5bb9e37b8a5f6209067ae.png"][/img][/carousel]
[h3][b]Strengthen Your Party by Changing Guild Adventurers' Weapons![/b][/h3]
Each time you explore dungeons with a guild adventurer, you'll accumulate Friendshop Points.
Once these points reach their maximum, you'll unlock the ability to change that adventurer's weapon.
By equipping adventurers with well-forged weapons, they'll become even more reliable and powerful members of your party.

[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354456/3b6ad66f2f2309ac328ed8525c9c847f91f25133.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354456/177389d2b4202a235c94a1d08455afc445d224aa.png"][/img][/carousel]
[h3][b]Customize Your Gear with Enchant Swapping![/b][/h3]
You can now freely customize the enchantments on your equipment.
By learning the "Enchantment Change" ability, a new feature will be added to the blacksmith menu, allowing you to modify enchantments.
Choose your favorite effects and create truly unique gear tailored to your playstyle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354456/ccc8ff20102d46792608ec19b3389057da442827.png[/img]
[h3][b]Skip Cleared Stages and Explore More Efficiently![/b][/h3]
A new feature now allows you to skip stages you've already cleared when exploring dungeons.
This is especially useful for players who want to farm materials from specific monsters or jump straight into boss battles - perfect for streamlining your gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354456/2d5c616954301cc5962677ff41be3235e80a1d3c.png[/img]
[h3][b]Collect Materials and Gold More Easily![/b][/h3]
The penalties for withdrawing from dungeon explorations or getting a game over have been removed.
Now, when you exit a dungeon - whether by choice or defeat - you'll be able to keep all the materials and gold you've collected up to that point.
This update makes resource gathering and exploration much more flexible and rewarding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354456/fc2d8c301cfaf428ffa64b9edea41a97640074b8.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Update in Development
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354456/20e5989fe6620e98ad30249faef8b498ad1e0ede.png[/img]

Dear Smith & Dungeon players,

Thank you very much for playing Smith & Dungeon!

We truly appreciate all the valuable feedback we’ve received, and are currently working on a major update to further improve the game.

The major update is scheduled for release at the end of June 2025.

[h2]Main Update Features[/h2]
[list][*]Addition of new high-difficulty content.
[*]New enchantments to further enhance equipment.
[*]A new feature to change existing enchantments on equipment.
[*]A new function allowing guild adventurers to switch their weapons.
[*]A stage skip feature for previously cleared areas.[/list]Please note that the above contents are subject to change without notice.

notes.title: Smith & Dungeon Gameplay Video Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354456/9bfd2f137025c4fdbaf9ec1d2b887b17bc91b956.png[/img]

We have released the gameplay video for Smith & Dungeon on the Steam store product page! Be sure to check it out!

In this video, you’ll see how players craft weapons and prepare their equipment at the fortress, recruit adventurers at the guild, and engage in thrilling battles using various weapons within the dangerous dungeons under the Demon King’s influence.

Smith & Dungeon is still in development, so some game content was not included in this gameplay video. However, in the next video, we plan to showcase everything we want to share with you. Stay tuned for more updates!

Additionally, we previously announced a release window of Q1 2025, but after reviewing our schedule, we have decided to shift the release to Q2 2025. We appreciate your understanding.

We are committed to delivering a game that meets your expectations. Adding Smith & Dungeon to your wishlist would mean a lot to us! Thank you for your support!
